exclusion_reason: These four issuers were used in pre-freeze exploratory Alpaca price probes and are excluded from the clean acceptance cohort.
selection_method: Among unique SEC CIKs with at least one ticker on an allowed exchange, excluding listed CIKs above, sort ascending by SHA256(seed + '|' + zero-padded CIK) then by CIK and take the first sample_size issuers. No price or return data may be queried before candidate membership is frozen.
candidate_rule: Include every 8-K or 8-K/A row whose SEC Items field contains 2.02 and whose filing date falls within the filing screen. Fetch and hash the immutable SEC primary filing before freezing membership. Publication-date eligibility and duplicate economic-event review occur later.
price_access_policy: No market-price acquisition for selected issuers until config/m1-frozen-candidate-ledger.json has been created and committed.
limitations: The SEC exchange list is a current selection frame, not a survivorship-free 2026-Q1 universe.
This is an engineering acceptance cohort, not a representative market-performance sample.
Foreign issuers, funds or other non-common securities can enter the issuer frame and must be excluded later by contemporaneous identity review.
A filing-date buffer through 2026-04-02 is used to capture late-filed disclosures; actual publication dates must still fall inside the protocol event window for inclusion.
